startupMetric: Process launch to first visible unowned top-level window (not first frame)
sampling: CPU window requested 30s with counter samples every ~5s; actual CPU/wall deltas retained; launch media position 0s, sampling begins after at least 20.5s media time and ten seconds settling. VLC media times are integer-quantized. Ordered variants rotate each round.
limitations: Warm OS caches; no cold-cache claim.
Video canvases match; actual child window dimensions/DPI are retained. Equal filter choices do not establish identical decoder or output pixels.
Samples cover owned root process only; inspect unexpected child processes separately.
Playback status does not prove pixels are visible or decoder hardware equivalence.
Child environment redirects ordinary profile/temp writes; Windows Known Folder APIs may bypass environment variables (VLC additionally uses portable/).
VLC RC verification adds a control-interface overhead.
MPC-HC uses a hidden /slave window to verify position; no decoder equivalence claim.

environment.source: Win32_ComputerSystem, Win32_OperatingSystem, Win32_Processor and Win32_VideoController CIM instances

purpose: Resource comparison; no overall player ranking.
visibilityMethod: Only the owned player is raised topmost before settling. Its canvas must be visible, unminimized, uncloaked, within one monitor, and free of detected foreign-window/cursor occlusion before and after each resource sample. Hit-test sentinels may reach the video, an owned video-host ancestor/descendant, or its exact owned layered ApertureOverlay control surface. Ownership/hit tests do not prove layer transparency or presented pixels; controlled GDI sentinel recognition is separate. Guards do not continuously observe intervals or check every pixel.
windowPlacement: Owned topmost comparison window at 40,40; not default window-manager placement.
runtimeManifestMethod: SHA-256 of ordinal-sorted UTF-8 lines: relative path with /, tab, byte length, tab, lowercase file SHA-256, LF. Source and staged runtime inventories must match before launch.
